title: Pure Mist Valley
summary: Pure Mist Valley self-bouncing Synchro and control deck, utilizing generic WIND Winged Beast and Tuner support. The deck revolves around bouncing cards to the hand to trigger Divine Wind of Mist Valley, establishing the infamous infinite negation loop of Mist Valley Apex Avian returning Mist Valley Thunderbird.

summary.title: Starters
points: Divine Wind of Mist Valley Special Summons a Level 4 or lower WIND monster directly from your Deck whenever a face-up WIND monster you control returns to the hand.
Harpie Dancer targets a WIND monster you control to return it to the hand, then grants an immediate extra Normal Summon of a WIND monster, triggering Divine Wind effortlessly.
Mist Condor Special Summons itself from hand by returning a face-up Mist Valley monster you control to the hand without using a Normal Summon.
Swallow's Cowrie Tributes a Winged Beast from hand or field to add a Winged Beast with the same Level from Deck to hand, searching Apex Avian or Harpie Dancer.
Genex Ally Birdman returns a face-up monster to hand to Special Summon itself as a Level 3 Tuner.

summary.title: Opening: Divine Wind + Harpie Dancer
steps: Activate Divine Wind of Mist Valley (searched via Terraforming if needed).
Activate Harpie Dancer's effect targeting herself, bouncing her back to your hand and triggering Divine Wind of Mist Valley.
Divine Wind Special Summons Mist Valley Thunderbird from your Deck.
Use Harpie Dancer's extra Normal Summon to summon her again, or use Swallow's Cowrie to search Mist Valley Apex Avian.
Advance your board into Synchro Summons like Mist Valley Thunder Lord or Link Summon Wynn the Wind Charmer, Verdant.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Mist Valley Apex Avian negates the activation of any opponent card or effect as a Quick Effect by returning a Mist Valley card you control to the hand; paired with Mist Valley Thunderbird, Thunderbird immediately Special Summons itself back to the field when bounced, creating repeatable omni-negation.
Mist Valley Thunder Lord returns a card you control to the hand as a Quick Effect during either player's turn to gain 500 ATK, triggering Divine Wind or recycling cards.
Mist Wurm targets and bounces up to three cards your opponent controls upon Synchro Summon.
Lightning Chidori is a Rank 4 Xyz that spins a Set card to the bottom of the Deck on summon and spins a face-up card to the top of the Deck by detaching a material.
Wynn the Wind Charmer, Verdant steals a WIND monster from the opponent's GY and searches a WIND monster with 1500 or less DEF if destroyed.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Divine Wind of Mist Valley is the deck's central engine Field Spell, converting every bounce into a free summon from the Deck.
Shrine of Mist Valley Special Summons a Level 3 or lower WIND monster from hand or Deck whenever a WIND monster on the field is destroyed by a card effect.
Swallow's Cowrie trades on-field or in-hand Winged Beasts for key combo pieces like Apex Avian or Dancer.

allow.Harpie Dancer: Level 4 WIND Winged Beast that bounces 1 WIND monster you control back to your hand to Normal Summon a WIND monster (instantly triggering Divine Wind of Mist Valley to summon a Mist Valley monster from the Deck!).
allow.Genex Ally Birdman: Limited to 1 in TCG: returns 1 face-up monster you control to the hand to Special Summon itself from your hand as a Level 3 Tuner.
allow.Swallow's Cowrie: Quick-Play Spell that tributes 1 Winged Beast in your hand or field to add ANY Winged Beast monster with the same Level from your Deck to your hand.
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches the essential Divine Wind of Mist Valley Field Spell.
allow.Lightning Chidori: Rank 4 WIND Thunder Xyz that spins 1 Set card and 1 face-up card your opponent controls into their Deck.
allow.Wynn the Wind Charmer, Verdant: Link-2 WIND monster that revives a WIND monster from the opponent's GY and searches a 1500 DEF WIND monster when destroyed.

main: Mist Valley Apex Avian

Signature Level 7 WIND Winged Beast boss (2700 ATK): once per Chain when a card or effect is activated (Quick Effect), returns 1 face-up 'Mist Valley' card you control (Mist Valley Thunderbird!) to the owner's hand to negate the activation and destroy it!
Mist Valley Thunderbird
Core Level 3 WIND Thunder: whenever this face-up card on the field returns to your hand, it immediately Special Summons itself back to your field—creating an omni-negate loop alongside Apex Avian!
Mist Valley Falcon
Level 4 WIND Winged Beast (2000 ATK): must return 1 card you control to the hand to declare an attack—immediately triggering Divine Wind of Mist Valley!
Mist Condor

Level 4 WIND Winged Beast: Special Summons itself from your hand by returning 1 face-up 'Mist Valley' monster you control to the hand—triggering Divine Wind of Mist Valley without using your Normal Summon!
Mist Valley Baby Roc
Level 2 WIND Winged Beast Tuner: whenever it is sent directly from your hand to the GY, it immediately Special Summons itself to your field for Synchro plays.
Mist Valley Shaman
Level 3 WIND Winged Beast Tuner: returns 1 other monster you control to the hand once per turn to gain 500 ATK.
Mist Valley Soldier
Level 4 WIND Winged Beast Tuner (1700 ATK): bounces any opponent's monster that battles it and is not destroyed by battle back to the hand.
Harpie Dancer
Bounces a WIND monster you control to the hand to Normal Summon a WIND monster, triggering Divine Wind of Mist Valley on Turn 1.
Genex Ally Birdman
Limited to 1 in TCG: bounces a monster you control to Special Summon itself and trigger Divine Wind of Mist Valley.
Divine Wind of Mist Valley
Limited to 1 in TCG: once per turn, if a face-up WIND monster you control returns to the hand, Special Summons 1 Level 4 or lower WIND monster directly from your Deck!
Shrine of Mist Valley
Field Spell that Special Summons a Level 3 or lower WIND monster from your hand or Deck whenever a WIND monster on the field is destroyed by card effect.
Swallow's Cowrie
Tributes a Winged Beast to search Mist Valley Apex Avian, Mist Condor, or Harpie Dancer from your Deck.
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Divine Wind of Mist Valley.
